<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013062025-11-2613-05-04" status="finalized" part="M" next="ex013062025-11-2613-05-44"> 
            <milestone n="Closing verses (7a6-7a7)" unit="section"/>
            <milestone n="V.2" unit="section"/>
            <lg><l>dge ba 'di yis tsha rabs kun tu <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">bdag</rs> ||</l> <l>byang chub sems dang mthu yis dpa' rnams kyi ||</l> <l>zab yangs ngo mtshar rmad kyi spyod pa la ||</l> <l>mi 'jigs <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">brtson 'grus seng ge</rs>'i stobs ldan shog || ||</l></lg> <note type="translation">Thanks to the virtue [of composing] this [commentary], in all [my future] lives, may I have fearlessness, diligence, and the lion’s strength {Alternatively: may I have the strength of a fearless diligent lion}, towards profound, extensive, wonderful, and marvelous practice of heroes, by means of the mind and the power of Bodhi.</note></seg></TEI>
